settingLabels.returns.time_zone.descript: The time zone, as an IANA name such as Europe/Warsaw, in which the free-return window and the consumer's withdrawal period count calendar days: each ends at the end of its last day in this zone, and a last day on a Saturday or Sunday moves to the Monday. Sales-channel value overrides the global value.
errors.RETURN_ALTERNATIVE_RESOLUTION_CON: A consumer's withdrawal is settled as a refund. Record the consumer's consent before settling it as credit toward future orders, a replacement or a repair.
consent.explanation: This case is a consumer's withdrawal from a distance contract. It is refunded by the same means of payment the consumer used, unless they expressly agreed to credit toward future orders, a replacement or a repair.
consent.none: No consent to credit toward future orders, a replacement or a repair is on record.
consent.noteHint: Where the consent is documented, for example: the customer's e-mail of 10 Nov 2026, ticket #123.
consent.frozen: The case is settled, so consent can no longer be recorded, changed or revoked.
consent.closed: This case is closed, so its consent can no longer change.
consent.requiredHint: Credit toward future orders, a replacement and a repair need the consumer's consent on record.
settlement.refundMethodDiffers: This is not the method the order was paid with. A consumer withdrawal is refunded by the same means of payment unless the consumer agreed otherwise. You can still settle; the audit log records the difference.
consent.revokeExplanation: The consent and its evidence note are deleted. The audit log keeps what was agreed to and when, but not the note. Credit toward future orders, a replacement and a repair close again until a new consent is recorded.
consent.replaceIntro: The new consent replaces the one on record, evidence note included. All fields are required.
consent.error.resolution: Choose what the consumer agreed to.
consent.error.givenAtMissing: Enter the date and time the consumer gave consent.
consent.error.givenAtFuture: The consent cannot be dated in the future.
consent.error.givenAtBeforeFiled: The consent cannot be dated before the return was filed.
consent.error.note: Say where the consent is documented.
settlement.paymentMethodIdHint: The list of payment methods could not be loaded, so enter the method's ID.
reject.explanation: The case is closed as rejected. The customer sees this reason on their return and in the rejection e-mail.
reject.error.reasonMissing: Enter the reason for rejecting the return.
reject.error.reasonTooLong: The reason is too long. Shorten it to {max} characters or fewer.
